description: This file defines the ElevationBasicFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for inflating a layout with interactive UI elements. It handles touch events on a shape to dynamically change its elevation (translationZ) to create a visual elevation effect, leveraging touch interactions to simulate elevation changes.

classes.name: ElevationBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing a layout with a shape that responds to touch events by changing its elevation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and enables options menu handling.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, finds a shape view, and sets a touch listener to change its elevation on touch events.
